text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin my evaluation, how old are you and do you have any known history of smoking or alcohol use?

text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those symptoms.
